effects.actual_behavior: Every effect tick refreshes dimensions and clears noGravity. Touching ceiling means verticalCollision && !onGround; near-ceiling upward motion also admits the control. Three-argument removal hook is inactive; it does not provide native exit cleanup.

effects.actual_behavior: Native attribute template is movement-speed -1 ADD_MULTIPLIED_BASE for admitted recipients: old three-argument arthropod-filter hooks are not dispatched. Non-arthropods above half maximum health request anonymous magic1 every eligible tick, ignoring hurt return. At stored duration1 request magic(amp+1)*30, ignoring acceptance; amp>0 creates a baby Tarantula Hawk above a nonempty-block scan capped at Y256, with spawn Y+.1F; server finalizes BREEDING and adds it. Then clear noGravity/noPhysics independently of hurt acceptance. Early effect removal supplies no proven three-argument physics cleanup. Scheduler lastDuration belongs to the shared effect object.
